source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A man came back from a long trip and told stories.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: קפצתי קפיצה ענקית באי.
sentences.en: He said: I made a huge jump on the island.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: כל האנשים שם ראו אותי.
sentences.en: He said: everyone there saw me.
One friend looked at him and said nothing.

sentences.ar: אחר כך החבר אמר: תקפוץ פה.
sentences.en: Afterwards the friend said: jump here.
The one who does it does not need to tell it.
